pages.title: Be Kind One to Another
pages.child_instruction: Color the children inviting a lonely child to join the festival game.
pages.bible_connection: Inviting someone in is a picture of being kind and tenderhearted, as Ephesians 4:32 teaches.
pages.visual_prompt: Integrated black line-art coloring scene: fall-festival game booth, two children waving a lonely child over to an extra chair, cider cups on a rail, a ring-toss game. Not a copy of Mission 1's church-and-lanterns scene. No letters in the artwork.

pages.title: Find the Kindness Gifts
pages.child_instruction: Find and circle all 8 kindness gifts. Each one can help you be kind at the festival.
pages.bible_connection: Looking for kindness gifts is practice for being kind, tenderhearted, and ready to forgive.
pages.visual_prompt: Controlled festival-booth background without the eight targets. Independently placed ticket, cider cup, kind note, extra chair, smile badge, bandage, shared pretzel, and extra game ring.

pages.title: Bring a Friend to the Game
pages.child_instruction: Start at the child sitting alone. Follow the path to the game table.
pages.bible_connection: Walking over to include a friend is a picture of being kind one to another.
pages.visual_prompt: One festival-grounds scene: child on a bench at START, unique booth-and-path maze, game table with an extra chair at FINISH. Not a maze pasted on a blank page.

pages.title: How Can You Be Kind?
pages.child_instruction: Check ways you can be kind. Then draw yourself saving a seat for a friend.
pages.bible_connection: These choices help a child practice being kind, tenderhearted, and forgiving.
pages.visual_prompt: One chair-framed page: four illustrated choices, a large extra-chair drawing area, and a short prayer ribbon.
pages.drawing_prompt: Draw yourself saving a seat for a friend
pages.prayer: Jesus, help me be kind and ready to forgive.
